decisions.reason: It still has its own product page two years after launch and fits the firm's core compact construction portfolio, so the option value of keeping it on the market remains high.

It retained dedicated website presence through 2024 and is close to the firm's established construction equipment business, although demand still needs to prove itself more clearly than for the strongest launches.

Its move from a dedicated page in 2023 to only a brief mention in 2024 without any positive performance signal suggests weak traction in a support-intensive niche, so resources are better shifted to stronger underground options.
Continued dedicated promotion in 2024 and strong fit with the firm's loader and handling lineup make continued market presence the prudent choice.
The reported large order and statement that it is the most popular material lift in rental strongly reduce uncertainty and make withdrawal very unlikely.
The quantified early operating performance after seven months is a strong validation in a core underground mining segment, so management would keep and build on this product.
